digest.component_or_area: rebar bridge reconciler - multi-project ticket sync
propositions: Teams cannot use the bridge for multiple tracker projects against one codebase because project scope is hard-wired as a single scalar in three independent code locations (JiraConfig, fetcher JQL, applier guard).

The multi-project model must store project-to-repos mappings at the store level in .bridge_state/projects.json to prevent each repo's fetch pass from seeing other projects' tickets as remote deletions.

Ticket project field is tri-state (absent=legacy, empty=never-sync, explicit-key=sync-there) and migration writes zero events by resolving absent tickets against a legacy default seeded via idempotent ensure unit.

Multi-project inbound fetch must iterate the configured project set for base JQL and all three enrichment passes (parent/comment/issuelink), merging results per-project into shared snapshot keyed by issue to prevent silent data loss.
Outbound dispatch must record per-ticket project and relax cross-project guard from single scalar to set membership, while a ticket with explicitly empty project produces no outbound mutation.

A store with >1 project in mapping must carry 'multi-project-bridge' in .store-compat.json required_capabilities with fail-closed enforcement for older binaries, while single-project stores remain writable by older code.
